changelog:
• Dual-Player Pool & Curi Start (VideoPreloadManager): Maksimal 2 instance ExoPlayer di RAM, pre-buffer 2-3s untuk video N+1 di feed For You dan swap instan 0 ms.
• Curi Start Episode Player (Mobile & TV Zona 5): Pre-buffer 3-5 detik episode N+1 otomatis saat durasi mencapai 75% atau tersisa 15 detik.
• Swipe For You Sehalus TikTok: Menggunakan TextureView sinkron frame animasi geser Compose, beyondViewportPageCount = 1, settledPage trigger, dan poster cover fade 150ms setelah frame pertama (anti-layar hitam).
• Kompresi Hero TV: Batas decode 1280x720 (Precision.INEXACT) + RGB_565 + debounce 300ms + auto-clear memory cache saat masuk player.
• Zero Memory Leak: Pelepasan total resource player saat keluar layar.
